2.2.rationale: In the Indonesian source, there is no explicit provision that establishes cooperation/collaboration with non-government service providers (e.g., NGOs) as a mechanism. The text only (a) defines “Lembaga” as including government agencies and/or NGOs (Pasal 1 angka 30), and (b) describes FPKK as a networking/coordination forum and mentions “jejaring serta sistem rujukan” (Pasal 40 ayat (2) huruf c) and referral through FPKK when PPT lacks facilities (Pasal 13 ayat (4)). These are network/referral concepts, but they do not clearly mandate collaboration with NGOs specifically. The judge’s ‘No’ is consistent with the Indonesian text; thus the golden ‘Yes’ likely over-credited implied NGO involvement.
